Definition: Time to decide increases logarithmically with the number and complexity of choices.
UI_Application: Cut visible options per decision point; group and prioritize; highlight one recommended path.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Catalog filter modal: keep the deciders (province, price, camp type) visible and tuck rare filters behind ตัวกรองเพิ่มเติม; booking widget offers one primary action per view.
Do: Limit choices per decision point to what the task needs; break complex flows into steps.
Dont: Don't dump every filter or host setting on one screen; don't add options just in case.

Definition: Time to acquire a target is a function of the distance to and size of the target.
UI_Application: Make primary actions large and near the thumb/cursor; expand hit areas on small controls.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Booking widget CTA is size lg (h-12) full-width next to the price summary; a mobile sticky bar keeps จองเลย in the thumb zone; icon buttons are h-11 w-11 (44px) per DESIGN.md.
Do: Keep touch targets >=44px and place the primary CTA where the user's attention already is.
Dont: Don't hide the booking CTA below the fold or shrink tap targets to fit more content.

Definition: Working memory holds about 7 (plus or minus 2) chunks; practical capacity is often 3-4.
UI_Application: Chunk information into labeled groups; keep lists and menus short and structured.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Camp detail groups amenities into labeled sections instead of one 30-item list; host dashboard shows 4 headline stats with detail behind tabs.
Do: Chunk lists and forms into labeled groups of 3-7 items.
Dont: Don't make users remember values across screens; keep needed context visible.

Definition: Users spend most of their time on other sites and expect yours to work the same way.
UI_Application: Follow platform conventions for navigation, cards, checkout, and calendars.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Catalog cards follow the familiar OTA pattern (photo, title, price/night, rating); the availability calendar is a standard month grid; dates are check-in/check-out like every booking site.
Do: Reuse familiar booking-site patterns; differentiate on content and photos, not core interaction.
Dont: Don't invent novel interactions for search or booking that force relearning.

Definition: Elements placed close together are perceived as related.
UI_Application: Separate groups with space; keep labels near their fields and prices near their actions.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Booking widget keeps dates, guest count, and total price in one tight visual group, separated from reviews by section spacing (space-y-8).
Do: Use spacing tokens (gap/space-y) to signal grouping before reaching for borders.
Dont: Don't place a field's error message closer to the next field than to its own.

Definition: Elements that look alike are perceived as the same kind of thing.
UI_Application: Same role = same style; different role = visibly different treatment.
CampVibe_Tie_In: All catalog cards share one grammar (radius, shadow, type scale) so campgrounds read as one browsable set; every status uses the one Badge style per state.
Do: Keep one visual grammar per component role per DESIGN.md section 3.
Dont: Don't style two different actions identically; จองเลย and สอบถามที่ว่าง must differ in emphasis.

Definition: The mind completes incomplete shapes and patterns.
UI_Application: Use partial reveals (a cropped next card) to imply more content; keep icon forms simple.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Horizontal camp rows on Home show a partially cut next card signalling more to swipe; the gallery shows a +6 tile implying more photos.
Do: Let a cropped element at the container edge hint that content scrolls.
Dont: Don't align content flush to the viewport edge, hiding that more items exist.

Definition: Elements inside a shared boundary are perceived as one group.
UI_Application: Use cards and panels to bind related content; one card = one decision unit.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Each campground is one Card (rounded-3xl); the booking widget sits in its own bordered card so price, dates, and CTA read as a single decision unit.
Do: Use Card/border to bind price, dates, and CTA into one unit.
Dont: Don't mix unrelated actions inside one card region.

Definition: People separate a focal figure from its background instantly.
UI_Application: Dim or blur the background when a modal or overlay is the figure; put text on scrims over photos.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The photo-gallery lightbox dims the page; modal backdrops isolate the task; text over camp photos uses the approved bg-foreground/50 scrim idiom from DESIGN.md.
Do: Dim the background layer whenever an overlay carries the task.
Dont: Don't set text on busy photos without a scrim (fails both contrast and figure-ground).

Definition: Eyes follow lines and aligned paths; aligned elements read as a sequence.
UI_Application: Align repeated info along one axis so the eye sweeps one clean line.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Search results keep price and rating at identical card positions so the eye sweeps straight down; host onboarding steps sit on one horizontal progress path.
Do: Keep repeated info at identical positions across cards and rows.
Dont: Don't stagger key info (price sometimes top sometimes bottom of the card).

Definition: The one item that differs from its peers is the one noticed and remembered.
UI_Application: Make the single most important element visually distinct - exactly once per view.
CampVibe_Tie_In: จองเลย is the only primary-filled button in the booking widget; one แนะนำ badge on a catalog card makes that camp stand out in the grid.
Do: Reserve the isolation slot: one accent element per view.
Dont: Don't highlight several cards or CTAs at once - everything special means nothing is. Never use fake recommended flags (no dark patterns).

Definition: Interrupted or incomplete tasks are remembered better than completed ones and pull to be finished.
UI_Application: Show incomplete states with a clear resume affordance; persist partial progress.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Host onboarding shows โปรไฟล์ของคุณเสร็จไปแล้ว 70% with the next step; a camper's half-finished booking (dates picked) is resumable from the navbar.
Do: Persist partial progress and offer ทำต่อ (resume).
Dont: Don't guilt-trip with manufactured incompleteness or fake progress meters (dark pattern).

Definition: Items at the start and end of a list are recalled best (primacy and recency).
UI_Application: Put the most important items first and last; bury the forgettable middle.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The amenity list leads with deciders (Wi-Fi, ห้องน้ำ, ที่จอดรถ) and ends with a differentiator; the navbar puts ค้นหา first and profile last.
Do: Order lists by importance: strongest first second-strongest last.
Dont: Don't alphabetize decision-critical lists by default.

Definition: Experiences are judged mostly by their peak moment and their ending, not the average.
UI_Application: Invest disproportionately in the emotional high point and the final step of each flow.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Booking confirmation is the end: celebratory and clear (เตรียมตัวไปแคมป์ได้เลย + next steps); the photo gallery is the browsing peak - make it fast and beautiful.
Do: Polish the confirmation/success screen and the best moment of each flow.
Dont: Don't end a flow on a bare form or dead-end error; don't let checkout fizzle out.

Definition: Users perceive attractive interfaces as easier to use and forgive minor friction.
UI_Application: Visual polish buys trust and patience - but never fixes an actually broken flow.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The teal calm-confidence brand (DESIGN.md section 1) makes CampVibe feel trustworthy enough for prepayment-level decisions by first-time visitors.
Do: Keep token discipline and polish all 8 states (loading/empty/error included).
Dont: Don't use beauty to paper over a broken booking flow; test tasks not looks.

Definition: Effort accelerates as people get closer to a goal; visible progress motivates completion.
UI_Application: Show progress toward completion; give honest head starts; shrink perceived remaining effort.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Host onboarding progress bar; booking steps ขั้นตอนที่ 2 จาก 3; profile-completeness meter on the host dashboard.
Do: Show step position and remaining effort honestly (อีก 1 ขั้นตอน).
Dont: Don't fake progress or pad flows with filler steps to exploit momentum (dark pattern).

Definition: Under uncertainty people copy what others do.
UI_Application: Reviews, ratings, and booking counts reduce perceived risk at decision points.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The review section with rating breakdown on camp detail; catalog cards show the rating and review count (4.8 - 24 รีวิว) right where the shortlist decision happens.
Do: Show real verifiable reviews and counts; surface recency and reviewer context.
Dont: Never fabricate reviews counts or live-activity numbers (มีคนดูอยู่ 12 คน must be real) - fake social proof is a dark pattern and illegal in several markets.

Definition: Perceived limited availability increases desire and urgency.
UI_Application: Communicate true availability constraints as information that helps timely decisions.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The availability calendar states real remaining capacity (เหลือ 2 จุดกางเต็นท์ในวันที่เลือก) helping campers decide before weekends sell out.
Do: State real scarcity from live availability data only, phrased as neutral information.
Dont: Never show fake countdowns, invented เหลือห้องสุดท้าย, or pressure banners - no dark patterns per docs/context non-negotiables.

Definition: The first number seen biases every later value judgment.
UI_Application: The first-shown price or option sets the reference frame for everything after it.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The nightly price is the anchor on cards and detail; extra fees appear early beside it (ราคารวม 1,890 บาท / 2 คืน) - never revealed late at checkout (drip pricing).
Do: Anchor with the real typical price and show the total cost early.
Dont: Don't anchor with inflated fake was-prices or hide fees until the last step (dark pattern).

Definition: The same fact lands differently depending on how it is framed (gain vs loss).
UI_Application: Choose frames that inform rather than manipulate; prefer the clearer kinder frame.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Cancellation policy copy: ยกเลิกฟรีก่อนเข้าพัก 7 วัน (gain frame) reads better than a penalty threat while stating the same rule.
Do: Frame policies positively and precisely; test comprehension with real users.
Dont: Don't use fear-framing to push bookings; a frame must never contradict the actual policy.

Definition: Losses feel roughly twice as strong as equivalent gains.
UI_Application: Reduce the perceived risk of committing; make reversibility visible at the decision point.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The free-cancellation badge on catalog cards and in the booking widget directly reduces the camper's feared loss at the moment of commitment.
Do: Emphasize reversibility (ยกเลิกฟรี) and safety nets where they are true.
Dont: Don't weaponize loss (คุณกำลังจะเสียส่วนลด!) to force action - that is a dark pattern.

Definition: People overwhelmingly stick with preselected options.
UI_Application: Defaults are the strongest nudge in the interface; set them for the user's benefit.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Guest count defaults to 2; sort defaults to แนะนำ; marketing notification opt-ins default OFF per PDPA and docs/context non-negotiables.
Do: Default to the most common safest choice and make changing it trivial.
Dont: Never pre-tick options that cost money or share data (pre-ticked add-ons = dark pattern + PDPA violation).

Definition: Too many options reduce satisfaction and can prevent any choice at all.
UI_Application: Curate, rank, and paginate; offer smart defaults and small recommended sets.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The catalog shows a ranked filtered page (~20 camps) not the whole inventory; แนะนำสำหรับคุณ rows narrow to ~6; the filter modal groups options into sections.
Do: Rank by relevance and reveal more on demand.
Dont: Don't render 200 unranked camps or 40 flat filters at once.

Definition: Show only what the current step needs; reveal detail and expert options on demand.
UI_Application: Layer complexity: overview first then detail then advanced settings.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Camp detail shows summary amenities with ดูทั้งหมด; the host camp form starts with essentials and hides advanced pricing behind an expander; the สอบถามที่ว่าง inquiry form asks only name, phone, and dates.
Do: Defer secondary fields behind expanders, steps, or sheets.
Dont: Don't front-load every host setting into one giant form.

Definition: Recognizing an option is far easier than recalling it from memory.
UI_Application: Show choices, history, and suggestions instead of empty inputs.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The search modal shows recent searches and popular provinces as FilterChips; the date picker shows a calendar not a text field; the lead inbox (upcoming) offers canned reply templates.
Do: Offer pickers, suggestions, and visible history everywhere input is expected.
Dont: Don't require typing exact camp names or province spellings from memory.

Definition: Engagement soars when system response stays under ~400ms; attention breaks beyond it.
UI_Application: Respond within 400ms or give immediate perceived feedback (optimistic UI skeletons).
CampVibe_Tie_In: Wishlist hearts and filter chips update optimistically; the API p95 < 200ms budget (performance.md) and the loading.md matrix keep perceived pace during real waits.
Do: Keep interactions under 400ms; use optimistic updates for toggles and likes.
Dont: Don't block the UI on a full round-trip for a simple toggle.

Definition: Every system has irreducible complexity; someone must absorb it - prefer the system over the user.
UI_Application: Absorb complexity into smart defaults, automation, and computed values.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The price calculator absorbs the fee math (nights x price + extra fees) into one total; availability logic disables already-booked dates instead of erroring after submit.
Do: Let the system compute, validate, and prevent invalid states upfront.
Dont: Don't push complexity onto users (manual total math or error-after-submit for knowable conflicts).

Definition: Be liberal in what you accept and conservative in what you send.
UI_Application: Accept varied input formats then normalize; emit clean strict output.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The phone field accepts 081-234-5678 spaces or bare digits and strips to 0812345678 before the shared zod check (ux.md catalog); dates accept tap or typed entry.
Do: Normalize input (trim strip separators) before validating against the catalog rule.
Dont: Don't reject a valid phone or email over cosmetic formatting the system can strip.

Definition: The just-noticeable difference is proportional to the baseline magnitude.
UI_Application: Changes must be proportionally large to be noticed; evolve interfaces gradually.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Discounts: ลด 50 บาท looks negligible against a 5,000-baht booking but big against 300 บาท - show percent where the base is large; redesigns change one grammar at a time.
Do: Scale the emphasis of a change or delta to its relative size.
Dont: Don't expect users to notice tiny relative changes - and don't shock them with wholesale redesigns.

Definition: Every action needs a timely visible response for users to build a correct mental model.
UI_Application: Confirm every state change - visual, textual, or auditory - within perception limits.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The wishlist heart fills instantly; booking submit walks loading -> success toast จองสำเร็จแล้ว; host edits show a saved state; replied leads get marked in the lead inbox (upcoming).
Do: Acknowledge every mutation within ~100ms (optimistic or per the loading.md matrix).
Dont: Don't allow silent successes or silent failures anywhere.

Definition: People act consistently with their prior commitments - especially small voluntary ones.
UI_Application: Small first asks pave the way to bigger ones; design a commitment ladder.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The สอบถามที่ว่าง inquiry is a low-commitment first step that raises later booking likelihood; saved wishlists bring campers back to their shortlist.
Do: Design the ladder: browse -> save -> inquire -> book.
Dont: Don't lock users in with guilt copy - commitment must stay voluntary (no dark patterns).

Definition: People value things more once they feel ownership of them.
UI_Application: Let users customize claim and save before purchase to build attachment.
CampVibe_Tie_In: A camper's saved wishlist and named trip (ทริปวันหยุดยาว) feel owned; hosts who personalize their camp page with photos and a story invest in maintaining it.
Do: Enable saving, naming, and personalizing early in the journey.
Dont: Don't exploit endowment with fake reservation holds implying loss of their booking (dark pattern).

Definition: People place higher value on things they helped create.
UI_Application: Co-creation (profiles listings itineraries) increases perceived value and retention.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The host listing builder: writing the camp story and arranging photos makes hosts value and maintain the listing; campers who build trip plans return to them.
Do: Make creation flows satisfying with visible polished results.
Dont: Don't add pointless effort just to trigger investment - the effort must produce real value.

Definition: Repeated exposure to something breeds familiarity and preference.
UI_Application: Consistent brand elements become familiar then trusted across touchpoints.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The teal palette and one card grammar repeat across Home, catalog, detail, and email so every touchpoint compounds familiarity instead of resetting it.
Do: Keep the brand and visual grammar stable across touchpoints (DESIGN.md tokens).
Dont: Don't restyle surfaces frequently; familiarity is a compounding asset.

Definition: Users ignore elements that look like ads or sit in ad-typical positions.
UI_Application: Important content must not resemble a promotion or a dismissible strip.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Platform announcements (new provinces seasonal openings) render as in-flow content rows in the standard card grammar; host alerts live in the dashboard task list not a top banner.
Do: Integrate critical messages into the content flow with the standard grammar.
Dont: Don't style key notices as colorful full-width banners with a CTA button.

Definition: On text-heavy pages users scan in an F shape: top line, shorter second line, then down the left edge.
UI_Application: Front-load keywords; use strong left-aligned hierarchy and scannable lists.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Camp descriptions and policy pages lead each block with the key fact (ยกเลิกฟรี... ราคารวม...); the review list puts rating and title first on each row.
Do: Put decision-critical words in the first two words of headings and list items.
Dont: Don't center long Thai paragraphs or bury key policy facts mid-paragraph.

Definition: On sparse visual pages eyes sweep top-left to top-right then diagonally to bottom-right.
UI_Application: Put the logo top-left and the primary CTA at the top-right and bottom-right terminals.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Home hero: brand top-left ค้นหาแคมป์ CTA at the Z terminal; landing sections end with their action at the bottom-right resting point.
Do: End each visual section with the CTA on the scan terminal.
Dont: Don't scatter CTAs into mid-diagonal dead zones.

Definition: The load inherent to the task itself - it cannot be removed only supported.
UI_Application: Simplify the representation of hard tasks; juxtapose the information the decision needs.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Choosing dates for a group trip is intrinsically hard: the availability calendar shows price and availability per day in one view so campers stop juggling screens.
Do: Support intrinsic load by co-locating linked info (price on the calendar day).
Dont: Don't split intrinsically linked info across screens (dates here prices there).

Definition: Load added by poor presentation - noise clutter and inconsistency.
UI_Application: Remove decoration, redundancy, and mixed grammars; every element must earn its place.
CampVibe_Tie_In: DESIGN.md anti-slop rules exist to cut extraneous load: one grammar for pickers no decorative badges light chrome so camp photos carry the information.
Do: Audit each element against the booking decision; cut what does not serve it (Lean rule).
Dont: Don't add ornaments, duplicate CTAs, or mixed component styles.

Definition: The useful load spent building mental models and learning the system.
UI_Application: Consistent patterns convert effort into transferable learning that makes later use automatic.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The first booking teaches the pattern (dates -> guests -> confirm); every later camp reuses it exactly so camper effort shifts to choosing the right camp not re-learning UI.
Do: Keep flows identical across camps and pages so learning transfers.
Dont: Don't vary the booking flow per camp type without a real need.

Definition: People perceive complex scenes in their simplest possible organized form.
UI_Application: Prefer simple regular layouts; reduce visual ambiguity so scenes parse instantly.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The catalog grid uses uniform card shapes in a regular grid that parses at a glance; the map view clusters pins into simple count bubbles instead of pin soup.
Do: Choose the simplest layout that carries the content.
Dont: Don't build irregular collage layouts for browsable inventory.

Definition: Grouping information into meaningful units expands what users can hold and parse.
UI_Application: Format data into culturally familiar chunks; break walls of content into labeled sections.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Phone renders as 081-234-5678 (masked 081-•••-••XX per ux.md); prices as 1,890 บาท with tabular-nums; amenities chunked by category (สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวก / กิจกรรม).
Do: Format numbers dates and lists into recognizable chunks (tabular-nums per DESIGN.md).
Dont: Don't show raw unformatted strings (0812345678 or 189000).

Definition: Visible effort by the system increases perceived value even at equal wait time.
UI_Application: Show meaningful work indicators when real work happens; be transparent about what is running.
CampVibe_Tie_In: A search over many camps may show กำลังค้นหาแคมป์ในเชียงใหม่... with progressive results; the upcoming AI assistant streams its answer so the work is visible.
Do: Show what the system is doing when the wait is real (per the loading.md matrix).
Dont: Don't add fake delays to simulate effort - artificial waits are deceptive and violate the Doherty threshold.

Definition: People feel obliged to return favors and value received.
UI_Application: Give genuine value first (guides tools answers) before asking for signup or reviews.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Free camping guides and checklists come before account prompts; the review ask lands after a completed stay when the platform has already delivered value.
Do: Lead with value; time your asks after value has been delivered.
Dont: Don't gate basic browsing behind signup walls; engineered obligation is a dark pattern.

Definition: One salient positive trait colors the judgment of everything else.
UI_Application: First impressions (photo quality overall polish) transfer to trust in the whole product.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Camp cover-photo quality drives perceived camp quality - photo guidance for hosts pays off platform-wide; a polished booking widget makes payment feel safe.
Do: Invest in hero photos and the first-viewport impression.
Dont: Don't let one neglected surface (a broken empty state) taint trust in the booking flow.

Definition: Pictures are remembered far better than words.
UI_Application: Lead with imagery for browsing and recall; support with concise text.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The catalog is photo-first (aspect-video cover per card); amenity rows pair lucide icons with labels; map pins show photo previews to help recall of shortlisted camps.
Do: Pair every key concept with an image or icon.
Dont: Don't rely on text-only lists for camps users need to remember and compare.

Definition: An asymmetrically dominated third option shifts choice toward the intended target.
UI_Application: Comparison sets steer choices; compose them only to clarify real trade-offs.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Host pricing tiers (จุดกางเต็นท์ / จุดกางเต็นท์+ไฟฟ้า / กลามปิ้ง) frame value honestly when each tier reflects a real offering campers can compare.
Do: Present honest option sets that reflect genuine value differences.
Dont: Never add a fake decoy tier engineered only to steer purchases - manipulative pricing is a dark pattern per docs/context non-negotiables.

Definition: People continue an endeavor because of invested effort even against their own interest.
UI_Application: Users resist abandoning long flows; keep flows short and exits honest so completion means intent.
CampVibe_Tie_In: The booking flow stays at 3 steps so nobody books merely because they have come this far; the inquiry form is 4 fields.
Do: Keep required commitment proportional to progress; allow saving and leaving freely.
Dont: Don't exploit sunk cost with long flows plus scary exit warnings designed to trap completion (dark pattern).

Definition: How choices are arranged changes decisions even when the options are identical.
UI_Application: Order, defaults, and grouping are design decisions with ethical weight; disclose influence.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Sort order แนะนำ must reflect camper value (rating fit availability) not paid placement; if sponsored slots ever exist they carry an explicit โฆษณา label.
Do: Architect choices for the user's benefit and disclose any commercial influence.
Dont: Never disguise ads as organic results or bias defaults against the user - transparency per docs/context non-negotiables.

Definition: Prior stimuli shape how later information is interpreted.
UI_Application: Set context with imagery and copy before the user reaches a decision.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Hero imagery of calm forest mornings primes the escape-the-city mindset before search; the review section primes with the rating summary before individual reviews.
Do: Prime with authentic mood-setting content that matches the real experience.
Dont: Don't prime expectations the camps cannot deliver (misleading imagery backfires into bad reviews).

Definition: People act on aspirations more at temporal landmarks (new year new month holidays).
UI_Application: Time prompts campaigns and nudges to natural fresh-start moments.
CampVibe_Tie_In: Seasonal collections (แคมป์รับลมหนาว) and long-weekend prompts align with Thai holiday landmarks when trip intent spikes; hosts get nudged to refresh photos before high season.
Do: Schedule engagement around real Thai holidays and seasons.
Dont: Don't spam generic prompts detached from meaningful moments.

Definition: Experts cannot imagine not knowing what they know; interfaces leak internal jargon.
UI_Application: Write for the first-time visitor not for the team; test copy on outsiders.
CampVibe_Tie_In: DESIGN.md section 4 bans technical jargon in UI copy: บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ ลองใหม่อีกครั้ง not validation error 400; the host dashboard explains อัตราการตอบกลับ in plain Thai.
Do: Test copy on someone outside the project; use plain Thai per DESIGN.md section 4.
Dont: Don't ship internal terms (endpoint sync cache API) into user-facing copy.
